runtime_implementation.scope: Sweep1/sweep2/profile sweep, loft and four-sided network, revolve/extrude/rail revolve, planar/patch, trim/split/untrim/shrink, rebuild/refit/softedit, match/blend/join, offset/fillet/chamfer/thicken, UV reverse/isocurve/seam and normal extrude/unroll.
remaining: All ten M03-UI surface workflows (selection, preview, commit/cancel, warning) are unsigned.
Network is four-sided Coons; n-sided networks are not implemented.
Match is a boundary-row replacement with a measured angle, not a full optimization.
Seam is a C0 metadata closure, not a true periodic re-parameterization.
Unroll is an average arc-length planar map; exact developable unroll is not claimed.
Portable surface offset is a sampled/refit approximation; exact offset remains OCCT.
